title: Midday pulse: console tooling standup - UI, rollouts, analytics
body:
Summary:

Quick midday sync focusing on three threads: UI responsiveness regressions observed in last canary, rollout gating logic improvements, and analytics ingestion/backfill problems. Meeting was intentionally short (25 minutes) to capture immediate blockers and owners for hotfixes and experiments.

Attendees:
- Aisha Patel (owner)
- Marcus Lee (frontend)
- Priya Raman (analytics)
- Diego Alvarez (reliability)
- Sophie Nguyen (product manager, rollouts)

Timebox: 25 minutes (10:30–10:55 PT)

Quick wins / Observations:
- Canary at 10% yesterday showed a 120ms median increase on panel load for users with >8KB state. Marcus traced this to a new serialization path introduced in PR 624 which adds an extra JSON.stringify for nested props. Temporary rollback patch under review (GH #624).
- Debounce fix merged into edge bundle reduced duplicate click events in panel actions by ~85% for a sampled cohort. Sanity checks in staging look good.
- Analytics: backfill job for session_start events failed due to timezone parsing when legacy logs include offset-less timestamps. Priya patched parser; re-run scheduled for 03:00 UTC tonight.

Blockers / Risks:
1) Telemetry mismatch: some panels are reporting both legacy and v2 schemas, causing joins to drop ~6% of events in the funnel metric (Linear ENG-1347). Risk: rollout gating decisions are using corrupted baseline. Mitigation: pause expansion beyond 25% until backfill and schema reconciliation complete.
2) Observability spike: heap-based telemetry aggregator on prod cluster spikes memory when batching >2000 events in 2s window. Diego suspects a memory leak in the local bundler module introduced 2025-12-18. Short-term: reduce batch window to 1s for affected nodes, long-term: instrument and patch bundler.
3) Canary thermals: Dedicated nodes in eu-west had slight throttling during the canary causing tail latency outliers. Sophie to coordinate with infra to norm CPU pinning for next canary.

Metrics snapshot (last 24h, rough):
- Panel load median: +120ms for canary group, control stable
- Duplicate action events: down from 0.7% to 0.1% after debounce fix (sample cohort)
- Funnel drop at panel-loading stage: control 2.3% -> canary 8.7% (investigating)
- Analytics ingestion failures: 0.6% failed parses (legacy ts); patch reduces to 0.02% in local runs

Decisions made:
- Pause auto-increment rollout from 25% -> 50% until schema backfill completes (target: after tonight's backfill). Decision by consensus; Sophie assigned owner.
- Proceed with rollback of the serialization change on the edge bundle for canary cohort only (Marcus to open hotfix PR).
- Shorten telemetry batch window to 1s on affected nodes as emergency mitigation (Diego to run and monitor for 6 hours).

Action items (owners and rough ETA):
- Marcus: open and land hotfix rollback for nested-props serialization (PR branch: fix/serialization-rollback). ETA: today EOD PT.
- Priya: re-run backfill job for session_start (parser patch deployed) and validate funnel integrity. ETA: tomorrow 08:00 PT, report in morning standup.
- Diego: deploy batch-window change to two affected clusters and run 6-hour memory/ingest sweep. ETA: 1 hour.
- Sophie: hold rollout expansion and update rollout policy to require "funnel-stable" signal before +25% increments. ETA: change applied in rollout console by EOD.
- Aisha: coordinate canary replay and ensure telem dashboards show both v1/v2 schema counts; prepare a short briefing for leadership if funnel still degraded. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Notes / Threads worth logging:
- Repro steps for serialization regression: open panel with >8KB persisted state, inspect network payload (there's an extra stringify wrapper). Marcus created repro gist and linked in GH PR comments.
- Backfill caveat: backfill job will rehydrate legacy sessions into v2 schema; we must ensure idempotency to avoid double-counting session_start. Priya to add idempotent tokens.
- Long-term: prioritize instrumentation schema migration playbook (Confluence doc) and a lightweight validator that can run during ingest to reject mixed-schema payloads with explicit error codes.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Add a smaller canary group that targets high-state users specifically (to catch regressions like this earlier).
- Evaluate adding a synthetic test that runs panel-load under varied persisted-state sizes during every pre-release smoke test.

End note: This sync is intentionally tactical. We'll follow up with a deeper agenda item in tomorrow's weekly sync to convert hotfixes into permanent fixes and adjust observability alarms. If anyone sees new regressions after the rollback, please @channel in #console-tooling-ops and tag Aisha and Diego.

Relevant links (copied into linked_artifacts as well):
- Linear ENG-1347: https://linear.app/ENG/issue/ENG-1347-panel-telemetry-mismatch
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/624
- Instrumentation schema v2 (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Instrumentation+schema+v2
summary_short: Midday tactical standup capturing a serialization-induced UI latency regression, analytics backfill parser fix, batch-window mitigation for telemetry aggregator, and a pause on rollout expansion until funnel integrity is restored.
